title: «Gschichte Chischte»
txt:
Interactive video box by Niki Schawalder, Sven König and Ornella Cacace, 2006
Dachkantine, Toni Molkerei and ZHdK Festival Zurich

Nightlife guests confide their best stories to the running camera. At the touch of a button, the video system inside the cosy box records solo shows by party animals, philosophical conversations between friends, or theatrical performances without words by fellow artists.
